places.quote: I thought I saw Elizabeth, in the bloom of health, walking in the streets of Ingolstadt.
places.note: Narrator is in the town; the streets appear in a dream, but the setting is the town itself.

places.quote: the church of Ingolstadt, its white steeple and clock, which indicated the sixth hour
places.note: Church is identified by its town but has no proper name; it is viewed from the narrator's position.
